place.title: Place {ref} (sound sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 3 pins into column f, one pin per row: OUT into {hole.out}, GND into {hole.gnd}, VCC into {hole.vcc}. The round microphone points up, away from the breadboard.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins. If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture.

why: {ref} listens with its small microphone; whenever the sound is louder than the level set with its screw, it pulls its OUT pin LOW for a moment.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND pin to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref} from 3.3 V, so its output signal is never more than the Pico's 3.3 V.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}'s OUT: it drops to 0 for a moment on each loud sound and is 1 otherwise. The module drives this line itself.
